_comment: Cards for tests/unit/costs/test_discard_x_cost.py. `t_dx_engine` is Gix, Yawgmoth Praetor's 'Discard X cards' cost reduced to 'you gain X life', so the X the effect reads is visible on a life total. `t_dx_lands` narrows the cost with `discard_selector` ('Discard X land cards'), so the ceiling is the matching cards and not the hand. `t_dx_aimer` is the shape whose target filter reads X ('with mana value X'), so the announcement has to come before the targets; it costs {4} so that it is never its own aim.

cards.name: Test Discard X Engine
cards.oracle_text: {1}, Discard X cards: You gain X life.

abilities.text: {1}, Discard X cards: You gain X life.

cards.name: Test Discard X Lands
cards.oracle_text: Discard X land cards: You gain X life.

abilities.text: Discard X land cards: You gain X life.

cards.name: Test Discard X Aimer
cards.oracle_text: Discard X cards: Destroy target artifact with mana value X.

abilities.text: Discard X cards: Destroy target artifact with mana value X.
